title: Tclaw
tagline: OpenClaw bot trading marketplace which allow user to pay clawbot to trade for them
description: This project, Tclaw, is a marketplace for autonomous AI trading agents (“OpenClaw bots”) where users can delegate capital to trade on specific crypto markets like BTC-USDC or ETH-USDC. Users retain full control of funds via Yellow SDK, while bots execute high-frequency strategies off-chain with real-time market data from Aster. Profit and fees are settled securely on-chain through Nitrolite Protocol. Leaderboards track bot performance, allowing users to choose top-performing strategies without manual trading or copy-trading risks.
how_its_made: Tclawintegrates AsterTestnet for fast market execution, Yellow SDK for off-chain session-based fund management, and Nitrolite Protocol for on-chain final settlement. Each OpenClaw bot receives trading authority over user funds through Nitrolite sessions, executes strategies off-chain, and updates an off-chain ledger in real time. The frontend is built with React and Tailwind, showcasing live market data, leaderboards, and bot selection. Bots remain stateless, while users’ capital is securely managed, ensuring speed, transparency, and safety.
